articles.headline: Letter #347: Marc Stad (2026) — Dragoneer Founder | Be Patient, Then Be Bold
articles.summary: Marc Stad, founder of Dragoneer Investment Group (a top-tier late-stage growth equity firm), shares his investment philosophy built around patience and concentrated bets in high-quality compounders. The article includes a detailed Dragoneer Investment Checklist covering business quality, valuation, analytical rigor, market dynamics, and team assessment — reportedly used verbatim by current and former Dragoneer investors in IC meetings. Stad's framework emphasizes sustainable moats, capital efficiency, and the discipline to wait for the right moment before making bold concentrated positions.
articles.why_it_matters: For a reader with strong preferences for elite fund PM process, competitive moat analysis, and deep business diligence, Stad's checklist and philosophy offer a reusable mental model for evaluating growth-stage companies across tech and healthcare — directly applicable to portfolio construction in volatile AI/biotech markets.
